query: Can you review the writing in my materials science paper before I send it to Acta Materialia? Just tell me what's cluttered, passive or inconsistent, ranked by priority.
I keep switching between 'catalyst loading' and 'catalyst content' in my manuscript. Do a pass on terminology consistency and number formatting.
Give me a report on the prose quality of my Discussion section: wordiness, weak verbs, sentences that are too long. Don't rewrite it, I want to fix it myself.
review my writing in this hydrology paper, journal says it needs language editing
Please just rewrite this abstract so it's tighter and more precise, I'll paste the result straight into the submission system.
Here's my 280-page popular science book. Do a line and copy edit with tracked changes in Word and a style sheet.
Are the statistical tests in my clinical trial paper appropriate? Check the methods and whether the results support the conclusions.
